identity_note: Matched Shield Technology Partners (shieldtp.com), the Thrive Holdings / ZBS Partners-backed MSP platform. Not Shield AI (defense drones, acquired Aechelon in 2026), which dominates search results for 'Shield'.

profile.name: Shield Technology Partners
profile.description: National IT services platform that takes controlling stakes in regional managed service providers ("ShieldCos"), keeps local leadership in equity, and supplies capital, operating support and its Forge AI operating system for IT services.
profile.location: Tampa, FL (Built In / Top Workplaces HQ); corporate roles also posted in New York City
profile.founder: Co-founders Jake Sloane, Frank Zhang and Casey Botts (launch press release, June 2025), with ZBS Partners and Thrive Holdings as founding sponsors. Jim Siders (ex-Palantir CIO) has been CEO since Dec 2025; he is an operating exec, not a founder.
profile.funding_detail: Over $100M at launch (June 2025) from Thrive Holdings and ZBS Partners, plus a second $100M from Thrive Holdings announced Feb 2, 2026, for product development and M&A. That is about $200M+ in total. OpenAI took an equity stake in Thrive Holdings in Dec 2025.
profile.headcount: Platform team: ~44 people named on shieldtp.com/our-team; Top Workplaces says 55 US employees; FastAIJobs says 51-200. The 20 ShieldCos employ far more (no consolidated figure published).
profile.past_completed_deals: 20 ShieldCos serving 3,750+ businesses (shieldtp.com/about). 2025: ClearFuze, IronOrbit, Delval Technology Solutions, OneNet Global (launch, Jun 2025), NetAscendant, SK Tech Group, BCS365, Option One Technologies (8th, Dec 2025). 2026: Nerds Support (20th, announced Sep 24, 2026); also listed on Shield's site or careers board: Liss Technologies, Exigent, boxIT, Crestwood Associates, Westerman, Threshold Communications, Christo IT, MyCLTech, Webistix.
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Finance (Director of FP&A, Director/VP of Strategic Finance, Senior Manager FP&A Revenue), Sales, Operations, Procurement and MSP field engineering at ShieldCos (18 open roles) as of 2026-10-08
profile.contact_path: https://shieldtp.com/contact (has a 'Partnership Query' / 'Refer an MSP' option); careers at https://shieldtp.pinpointhq.com/

verdict.headline: Active MSP acquirer · 20 deals in ~16 months · M&A seat now closed
verdict.detail: The Manager of M&A posting seen on Aug 24 is gone (its URL now redirects to the board root). The M&A function sits under Head of M&A Everett Brownstein.
